info.title: OpenBridge minimal text gateway
info.description: Envelope-level HTTP contract only. Detailed field admission and per-model representation limits are defined by the Chat and Responses text profiles; this is not the complete OpenAI schema. No models discovery, stateful resources or automatic retry/fallback.

post.summary: Generate through the single-candidate Chat text profile
Generate through the stateless Responses text profile

ProbeId.name: x-openbridge-probe-id
ProbeId.description: Operator correlation only when private probe diagnostics are enabled and authentication succeeds. Valid form: 32 lowercase hex run ID, colon, then decimal 1..999999. Invalid/duplicate values disable observation only, not business admission. Never forwarded upstream or echoed downstream. Not semantic request data.

bearerAuth.description: Exactly one Authorization header. Configured startup secret, not an upstream API key.

messages.description: User/assistant and system/developer content accepts a string or nonempty ordered plain-text part array. Tool result content accepts a string or ordered plain-text part array, including an empty array; single tool-result parts remain arrays. Media is not admitted.

max_completion_tokens.description: Bootstrap defaults absent/null to 1024 and rejects values above 16384 after semantic decode.

metadata.description: Typed request hint, never copied into reported response metadata.

service_tier.description: Request hint; the reported effective tier may differ. Endpoint context admission remains independent.

logprobs.description: Return token probabilities when true; null/false are inactive controls.

top_logprobs.description: A non-null integer requires logprobs:true; null normalizes to absent.

ChatRequest.description: Additional fields require admission by the Chat text profile and selected public contract; additionalProperties does not authorize arbitrary upstream parameters. Function-only tool_choice.allowed_tools uses the nested Chat shell. OpenBridge's Chat extension admits scoped openai-responses-v1 reasoning_details on assistant history; preserve those actual output details for replay rather than treating them as ordinary assistant text.

max_output_tokens.description: Bootstrap defaults absent/null to 1024 and rejects values above 16384 after semantic decode.

ResponsesRequest.description: Detailed input, settings and inactive-state admission follow the Responses text profile. Models with only a Chat startup entry return model_not_found here; no implicit protocol fallback. No arbitrary endpoint, credential or header selection.

Generation.description: A profile-specific JSON response or incremental SSE. The public model label is retained. Chat content_filter is an incomplete terminal distinct from length and refusal. Reported Chat text/prediction token details and content/refusal probabilities are retained; standard Responses projection rejects unrepresentable facts rather than dropping them. Static Chat metadata is reported independently from request hints and has no Chat SSE slot; such a static-to-SSE projection is rejected. HTTP 200 alone does not prove successful stream closure or model output adherence; late errors abort the body without a fabricated terminal.

Error.description: Sanitized application error. 401 includes WWW-Authenticate: Bearer. No upstream body, origin, credential locator or parser input is reflected. HTTP parser failures occur outside this envelope.
